post.description: By using either buyer_id OR card_token, capture an amount from the available credit. Optionally reference a pre-existing authorization.

schema.description: Real Time Account Updater (RTAU) Results. Returns only if query string `AU` is present.

reasonCode.description:
Always present when `AU` is requested. For more info on values, refer to [Account Updater Codes](/reference/account-updater).

 - `U`: Unsupported card brand (not Visa/MasterCard). No lookup performed; original card unchanged; no card object.  - ` ` (empty): RTAU completed and the network returned no reject reason (e.g., successful update / match).
 - other: Reject reason code returned by the card network's Account Updater service. TabaPay returns the value exactly as received.

403.description:
Bad request

| Error Code | Description |
|---|---|
| amount_mismatch | The amounts specified in the charge are not equal to the sum of the amounts in charge details |
| buyer_currency_mismatch | The specified currency is not matched with buyer currency |
